items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Also, my brother was married to Gina Fratini

ctx.x: You talked about it already. How did the book come about?

There was a guy – is a guy in Paris called Dave Pierce, who’s Canadian, who said to me, “Have you ever thought about writing a book?” I said, “Yeah, but I don’t know how you go about it.” So we collaborated. He would say, “What about fish?” I would say, “I think” blah blah blah. We went to see a publisher, and the publisher liked it. He put out a limited edition. I don’t think you can get this anymore. But it’s a good book, and the recipes in it are good recipes. Also, my brother was married to Gina Fratini, who…
